distance_metric_definitions.auc_neg_farther_than_pos: P(d_neg > d_pos) + 0.5 * P(d_neg == d_pos), within each matched positive and its 10 negatives; high is informative.
distance_metric_definitions.ordering_error_rate: P(d_neg < d_pos) + 0.5 * P(d_neg == d_pos), exact complement of auc_neg_farther_than_pos; low is informative.
distance_metric_definitions.fraction_negative_closer: Strict fraction P(d_neg < d_pos), with ties excluded.
